name: EuroSAT
description: EuroSAT is a remote-sensing land-use and land-cover image dataset built from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. It is distinct from BigEarthNet, which is a separate dataset and record.
citation: Helber, P., Bischke, B., Dengel, A., & Borth, D. (2019). EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing, 12(7), 2217–2226. https://doi.org/10.1109/JSTARS.2019.2918242

license.notes: The upstream EuroSAT repository does not state a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Review upstream terms and rights applicable to the imagery before use or redistribution.
